text:
olivia: FYI: Arcadia Logistics (acct AR-501) flagged by health checks  steady drop in active sessions (approx 38% down over 10 days). Renewal in 6 days, customer mentioned considering moving to Standard tier.

ben: Thanks. ARR and renewal contact?

olivia: $33k ARR, renewal owner is carlos@arcadia.com. Recent feedback: outputs are drifting from their domain lexicon, and they said the model "feels less accurate" in last sprint. NPS=3. Missed last onboarding follow-up.

mei: Any infra or error trends? latency? billing disputes?

olivia: No errors, p95 latency stable. Theres a support thread SUP-1201 about relevance of reranker results. Also, they enabled verbose system prompts last month which increased tokens per call.

arjun: Sounds like a mix of prompt drift + cost pain. Suggest a winback bundle: 1) immediate triage call, 2) prompt & endpoint audit, 3) a feature-gated canary with domain-tuned system prompts + dedup metadata, 4) a reversible downgrade shim if they insist, 5) short feedback capture survey to CTO. Tie any credits to completion of the triage.

olivia: Proposed checklist (owners & timeline). Keep light and exec-friendly.

```
- outreach email + 3-question feedback capture (owner: ben) within 12h
- 30m triage with engineering + product (owner: mei) within 48h
- prompt & token audit: identify top 3 token sinks and 2 prompt fixes (owner: arjun) by EOD after triage
- canary patch: domain prompt tuning + dedupe metadata + batching tweak (owner: arjun)
- run 7-day canary and show before/after token delta and relevance sample (owner: arjun)
- downgrade shim doc: feature mapping + migration checklist + rollback script (owner: mei)
- offer: 20% spend credit for one month contingent on workshop + canary (owner: ben)
- escalation: if no reply in 36h escalate to AM lead and open retention task (owner: olivia)
```

arjun: Running an initial usage query to get endpoint/token breakdown. Example query: 
```
SELECT endpoint, SUM(tokens) as tokens, COUNT(*) as calls FROM usage.events WHERE account='AR-501' AND ts>now()-14d GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;
```

mei: I'll prepare a one-pager for their CTO that shows two concise tracks: Optimize (recommended) and Downgrade (fallback). The Optimize track includes prompt tuning, small batching + prefix caching changes, and a short training dataset for domain phrases. The Downgrade track will include exact feature tradeoffs and a migration timeline.

ben: I'll send the outreach now and ask for Thu/Fri time slots. Will attach a quick survey: 3 questions: 1) primary blocker (cost/quality/ops), 2) willingness to run a short remediation, 3) decision timeline.

olivia: Customer feedback snippet from last call: "We used to get materially better match for shipment status messages; lately top results contain vendor names we don't use." That points to reranker tuning.

arjun: I'll prepare a small A/B sample to show reranker tuning effects on 5 sample queries and include token delta estimates. Also will prepare a tiny migration script that toggles the feature gate and reverses within 1 hour.

cse_bot: Account snapshot linked: https://redwood.app/account/AR-501/health | onboarding 38/100, last enablement 52 days ago, NPS=3. Save-play checklist created and attached to account timeline.

mei: If they accept the workshop, we aim to show a relevance uplift + token reduction within 5 days. If they still want to downgrade, we provide the shim + a mapped comparison of endpoints/features impacted.

ben: Outreach sent. I'll post responses and meeting link here. If no reply in 36h, I'll escalate.

olivia: Thanks all 44d Marking as high-priority save and assigning follow-up reminders.

cse_bot: Reminder set: follow-up ping in 36h if no engagement.
